title: Med-Surg Level 3: Two Carlsons, One MRN

fields.organization: Lakemont Community Hospital — Med-Surg Level 3 / Health Information Management
fields.location: Med-Surg Level 3 nurses' station; Rooms 309 and 311
fields.inspector: Patrice Dahlberg, Unit Clerk, Med-Surg Level 3
fields.summary: Two patients with the same last name are on the unit. Walter Carlson, 81, Room 309, was admitted Monday 02/08 and is on the 23:20 downtime census. Wendell Carlson, 79, Room 311, was admitted at 23:50 and is NOT on the census. The admitting label printed for Wendell carries Walter's MRN, and it is already on two of Wendell's downtime order sheets. At 04:06 the night pharmacy run delivered one med bag labelled with that MRN, name line 'CARLSON, W'. Nobody can say which patient it is for. The bag has not been opened or given.

findings.notes: On 23:20 census. Armband name and DOB match the MAR.
Admitted 23:50, after the 23:20 viewer refresh. Not on the census or the printed MAR.
Label shows Walter's MRN. Used on 2 order sheets before anyone caught it.
Name and DOB correct. MRN field matches the wrong label.
Both carry Walter's MRN on the label. One also has Wendell's handwritten name.
Labelled with the shared MRN, 'CARLSON, W'. Unopened, held at the nurses' station.

findings.item: Lab specimens sent on either Carlson since 23:50
findings.notes: Not yet checked with the Core Lab.

actionsTaken: 04:08 Stopped all label printing and placing for both Carlsons
04:09 Put the med bag in a sealed bag at the nurses' station, marked DO NOT GIVE — IDENTITY HOLD
04:10 Told the charge nurse; both charts placed together on the hold shelf
04:12 Called HIM, ext. 5430; transferred to Record Integrity Specialist Elena Moreau, ext. 5431
04:15 Brought both order sheets to the House Supervisor
recommendations: Per Elena Moreau (04:13): do not put another label on either chart
Per Elena Moreau: give Wendell Carlson a D- number from the downtime pad and handwrite his full name and date of birth on every sheet
Per Elena Moreau: both charts stay frozen until she reviews the master patient index
Decision needed from House Supervisor: who receives the held med bag, and who checks it against the armband
fields.photosNote: No photos. Original order sheets (2) and the empty label backing are attached to this report.
fields.signature: Patrice Dahlberg, Unit Clerk, Med-Surg Level 3
fields.marking: EXERCISE · EXERCISE · EXERCISE — all patients and record numbers are fictional

instructorNote: This is a core patient-identity inject: one record number now has two people's data on it, so it is a possible overlay. Check that the CNO stops use of the shared MRN, has a D- number assigned to Wendell, and keeps the med bag on hold until it is checked against the armband. Also check that the LPM flags both Carlsons in pharmacy and the Core Lab for identity review before any queued messages are replayed.
